tests.name: native_word_empty_datastore_preserves_body_and_round_trips
assertions: Exact paragraph text and count; empty data-store presence survives snapshot and canonical publication.
tests.scope_limit: Plain paragraph and empty metadata only; other producer metadata remains uncovered.

tests.name: native_word_write_reservation_keeps_exact_hash_and_five_paragraphs
assertions: Five native paragraph markers; exact 120-byte write-reservation SHA-256; absent legacy reservation; snapshot and model-writer preservation.
tests.scope_limit: Passive hash retention only; no authentication or document protection execution.

tests.name: native_word_run_edit_preserves_empty_datastore_and_source_snapshot
assertions: One body run replacement survives save/reopen with empty metadata and original source bytes intact.
tests.scope_limit: Single run replacement only; other transaction operations remain uncovered.

tests.name: native_word_datastore_documents_retain_markers_through_model_writer
assertions: Native body markers and full parsed body text survive canonical model writing; data-store presence and table/field counts retained.
tests.scope_limit: Counts do not establish semantic completeness of fields, pictures, objects, protection or embedded fonts.

tests.name: native_word_bidi_and_east_asian_text_retains_unicode_scalars
assertions: Exact Arabic, Hebrew, Japanese and Chinese text before and after canonical writing.
tests.scope_limit: Unicode text only; shaping, direction and East Asian layout properties remain uncovered.

tests.name: native_word_structural_opaque_tables_preserve_source_and_refuse_canonical_loss
assertions: Native table and body markers; empty data store retained on snapshot publication; canonical writer returns InvalidInput before writing any bytes for structural opaque owners.
tests.scope_limit: Explicit canonical-writer boundary from the current feature matrix; supported source-splice edits are tested separately.

tests.name: native_word_table_grid_exposes_all_four_cell_values
assertions: Exact 2x2 Table Grid cell values: Key, Value, RTF_CELL_006 and 42 before and after snapshot publication.
tests.scope_limit: Basic table read only; nested, merged and floating tables remain uncovered.

tests.name: native_word_table_cell_edit_preserves_every_unrelated_source_byte
assertions: Changing one table cell produces exactly the source bytes with its text replaced; neighbor cell and data store retained; source snapshot unchanged.
tests.scope_limit: Single table-cell text operation; no general opaque-owner edit claim.

tests.name: native_word_review_retains_insert_delete_and_comment_content
assertions: Two typed insertion/deletion revisions with expected native text; both native comment/reply texts survive canonical publication.
tests.scope_limit: Content and revision type only; authors, ranges, threading, accept/reject and review mutations remain uncovered.

tests.name: native_word_mail_merge_preserves_empty_file_table_and_inert_source
assertions: Empty file table, native merge settings, source/query text and cached conditional result; three standalone merge fields and two counters; metadata and body retained through canonical writing.
tests.scope_limit: No query execution, source access, field evaluation or merge execution; nested field syntax is retained in its parent instruction.

tests.name: native_word_table_style_retains_all_seven_conditional_definitions
assertions: Seven native table-style definitions with distinct scopes and unchanged based-on identity survive stylesheet writing; rich table document parses with body markers.
tests.scope_limit: Conditional format retention only; no application of styles or rendering, and no general table mutation claim.

tests.name: native_word_vector_group_retains_unstarred_result_and_source_bytes
assertions: Field-owned Graphic 3 group and its three-child legacy result retained; closed polygon has 20 points; body markers and exact original source bytes survive reopen.
tests.scope_limit: Known drawing properties and unchanged repeated section defaults only; no rendering or SmartArt semantic reconstruction.

tests.name: native_word_tracked_move_markers_coexist_with_insert_delete_revisions
assertions: Two move identities retain kind, tag, author and date; inserted/deleted moved text survives in revisions; source publication is byte-identical.
tests.scope_limit: No move execution or accept/reject; deleted text lives in revision content rather than visible body bookmark ranges.

tests.name: native_excel_metadata_reader_keeps_every_worksheet
assertions: All five worksheet names and accessible sheet handles; two exact consolidation ranges and source names; native 28-byte printer-driver payload.
tests.scope_limit: No print execution, consolidation recalculation or full metadata-family claim.

tests.name: native_excel_workbooks_never_silently_lose_worksheet_substreams
assertions: Expected worksheet counts for every unencrypted native XLS/XLT; exact retained SortData and key ranges in two native books; typed version-15 external table metadata.
tests.scope_limit: Catalog coverage plus selected sort/table metadata only; encrypted XLS and remaining worksheet semantics are separate work.

tests.name: native_doc_reads_unicode_paragraphs_through_public_views
assertions: Native body markers and multilingual Unicode text; paragraph query results propagate errors and resolve back through public paths.
tests.scope_limit: Main document text and paragraph traversal only.

tests.name: native_docx_reads_unicode_paragraphs_through_public_views
assertions: Native body markers and multilingual Unicode text; paragraph query results propagate errors and resolve back through public paths.
tests.scope_limit: Main document text and paragraph traversal only.

tests.name: native_xls_keeps_all_five_metadata_worksheets
assertions: Five exact worksheet names, rich/Unicode text markers, and complete cell-query traversal with resolvable paths.
tests.scope_limit: No full formatting, formula, print or metadata claim from text and traversal checks.

tests.name: native_xlsx_keeps_all_five_metadata_worksheets
assertions: Five exact worksheet names, rich/Unicode text markers, and complete cell-query traversal with resolvable paths.
tests.scope_limit: No full formatting, formula, print or metadata claim from text and traversal checks.

tests.name: native_xlsb_keeps_all_five_metadata_worksheets
assertions: Five exact worksheet names, rich/Unicode text markers, and complete cell-query traversal with resolvable paths.
tests.scope_limit: No full formatting, formula, print or metadata claim from text and traversal checks.

tests.name: native_ppt_reads_three_slides_and_table_text
assertions: Exactly three slides, fixture identity, bullet text and six native table labels/values through public presentation views.
tests.scope_limit: Slide text projection only; PPT shape-count fallback does not establish shape parsing correctness.

tests.name: native_pptx_reads_three_slides_and_table_text
assertions: Exactly three slides, fixture identity, bullet text and six native table labels/values through public presentation views.
tests.scope_limit: Slide text projection only; PPT shape-count fallback does not establish shape parsing correctness.

tests.name: native_rtf_edit_reopen_and_inverse_keep_the_original_word_source
assertions: Public run edit survives save/reopen; inverse patch restores exact source; whole-paragraph replacement of mixed formatting has a precise refusal and leaves input unchanged.
tests.scope_limit: Run text transaction only; other operation families remain uncovered.

tests.name: native_word_math_retains_inline_and_display_equation_trees
assertions: Two typed inline/display equations, exact run text, superscript/fraction/sum structures and properties; exact source publication and isolated typed-equation writer/reopen.
tests.scope_limit: No equation evaluation or layout; character formatting and fallback images remain source-owned; multiple equations in a display paragraph have a typed unsupported boundary.

tests.name: native_rtf_math_opens_through_the_facade_and_unmodeled_grouping_is_typed
assertions: Native body marker and exact facade publication; derived unsupported multiple-equation grouping returns UnsupportedCapability with Rtf format and source reason.
tests.scope_limit: The native document has one equation per display paragraph; the unsupported grouping case is synthetic.

tests.name: native_excel_validation_collection_exposes_all_seven_rules_and_cached_totals
assertions: Seven exact rule kinds/ranges, integer bounds and prompt title; cached totals14 and95.
tests.scope_limit: Classic validation read only; no validation evaluation or extension14 prelude claim.

tests.name: native_excel_validation_edit_retains_alternate_metadata_and_other_members
assertions: Error-title edit retains other rules, AC identity bytes and every unrelated package member; inverse restores exact source.
tests.scope_limit: One classic rule metadata change; source-bound package publication only.

tests.name: native_excel_validation_add_and_remove_preserve_existing_rules
assertions: Appending then removing B10 validation preserves seven native rules and restores all package members.
tests.scope_limit: Classic rule add/remove; no native-app reopen.

tests.name: native_validation_stream_refuses_broken_alternate_framing_and_counts
assertions: Six in-memory mutations verify missing/nonempty AC ends, malformed begin, orphan/excess prefixes and mismatched counts fail in reader and editor.
tests.scope_limit: Derived malformed inputs; original native fixture remains unchanged.

tests.name: validation_list_alternate_is_retained_or_replaced_without_losing_opaque_prefixes
assertions: Derived ACDVALLIST survives metadata edit; list replacement updates formula and retains every native opaque prefix.
tests.scope_limit: List-prefix variant is constructed in memory; native fixture supplies the other rule and identity records.

tests.name: native_excel_conditional_formatting_links_the_wrapped_data_bar_extension
assertions: Eight classic priorities and one extension; exact data-bar GUID link, three redundant-length and one absent-NULL-suffix report entries.
tests.scope_limit: Read/link and repair accounting only; no full conditional-format writer or rendering claim.

tests.name: native_conditional_repairs_do_not_accept_truncated_formulas_or_broken_wrappers
assertions: Strict low-level record parser refuses repair; true formula truncation, missing FRT end and partial NULL suffix remain errors.
tests.scope_limit: Derived corruptions distinguish bounded repair from accepting malformed data.

tests.name: native_excel_frozen_pane_matches_its_paired_xlsx_view
assertions: Frozen bottom-right pane at B2 with one-row/one-column splits; exact freeze-flag repair count.
tests.scope_limit: Paired native XLSX state provides independent expected semantics; other view state is not covered.

tests.name: native_excel_workbooks_materialize_every_declared_worksheet
assertions: All15 unencrypted native XLSB files open and materialize every worksheet with independently specified counts.
tests.scope_limit: Catalog/materialization coverage is not semantic coverage of each feature; encryption is excluded.

tests.name: native_excel_sparklines_retain_locations_identity_blocks_and_patch_inverse
assertions: Two column/line groups with four exact locations; line-weight edit retains other group, AC identities and unrelated parts; exact inverse and full-envelope removal.
tests.scope_limit: Formulas are retained, not evaluated; no render or native-app reopen claim.

tests.name: native_excel_slicer_views_keep_names_captions_and_alternate_identities
assertions: Region/Product names, captions and cache names; typed write/reopen and reordered caption edit preserve AC identities; duplicate identity and missing collection end rejected.
tests.scope_limit: View-part codec only; cache CRUD and filter execution are not covered.

tests.name: native_excel_timeline_resolves_native_relationships_and_retains_february_selection
assertions: Native cache relationship resolution, February2026 selection and Date month-level view/UID; typed XML roundtrip; spoofed MCE namespace rejected.
tests.scope_limit: Read and isolated codec write; native-source transactional edits, refresh and filtering remain uncovered.

tests.name: native_excel_let_parameter_name_and_cached_result_remain_inert
assertions: Exact LET/parameter/FILTER/SEQUENCE names, one missing-shortcut report, F4 formula status, original name tokens and cached50.
tests.scope_limit: Context-dependent UDF slot0x00FF intentionally remains opaque; this is formula retention evidence, not expression rendering or evaluation.

tests.name: native_excel_external_link_uses_referenced_relative_path_and_cached_values
assertions: Referenced relative path selected despite absolute alternate; three exact source sheet names, external caches49.75/14 and total63.75; untouched package members.
tests.scope_limit: No target fetch, link refresh, OLE activation or external-link edit claim.

tests.name: native_excel_streaming_structured_formula_uses_complete_sheet_catalog_positions
assertions: Source-backed Table1 has complete catalog position 1 after a chart sheet; streaming Sheet2!B4 resolves exactly SUM(Table1[Quantity]) with cached value 14.
tests.scope_limit: One structured table reference and cursor traversal, not general formula execution.

tests.name: native_sparkline_alternate_content_accepts_both_positions_but_rejects_broken_envelopes
assertions: Derived inside-group AC prefix reads; missing/nonempty AC ends and missing FRT end fail.
tests.scope_limit: In-memory framing variants only; original native prefix is before the group.

tests.name: native_powerpoint_group_keeps_both_text_shapes_and_the_connector
assertions: Slide 5 exposes one three-child group with SOURCE_002, TARGET_002 and the line/connector; exact original package bytes retained.
tests.scope_limit: Native grouped-shape read only; no connector routing, binding or rendering claim.

tests.name: native_powerpoint_decks_materialize_all_slide_shapes_without_dropping_any
assertions: Nine unencrypted PPT/PPS specimens retain exact slide counts, nonempty shape arrays for every slide, no UnreadableShape repairs and byte-identical publication.
tests.scope_limit: Materialization is not semantic completeness. Encrypted files have a separate test; animation, layout and rendering remain separate scopes.

tests.name: native_powerpoint_media_previews_resolve_by_slot_and_retain_exact_payloads
assertions: Three exact image slots, native kinds, byte lengths and SHA-256 values; per-slot access agrees with full enumeration; source publication is exact.
tests.scope_limit: Stored PNG/deflated EMF preview bytes only; no image decoding/rendering or playable media claim.

tests.name: native_powerpoint_placeholder_table_exposes_all_twelve_cells
assertions: Native content-placeholder table remains typed Table with 4 rows, 3 columns and all twelve exact cell strings.
tests.scope_limit: One basic native table; merged/complex table layouts remain uncovered.

tests.name: native_powerpoint_media_and_ole_placeholders_keep_typed_frames
assertions: Typed media and OLE preview frames retain external IDs; one inert WAV has duration 2000 ms, sound ID 1 and native flags; exact sound name/length; Excel.Sheet.12 metadata retained.
tests.scope_limit: The downgraded video has a media action but no ExObjRef or playable video payload; metadata does not establish a full embedded Excel payload. No playback or activation.

tests.name: native_powerpoint_text_and_table_edits_reopen_and_invert_without_losing_other_content
assertions: Composed title and table-cell replacements survive reopen; every other shape text, multilingual subtitle, speaker note and both property-set streams remain unchanged; replay and inverse are byte-exact.
tests.scope_limit: Focused source-bound text edits only; other table structure, formatting and CRUD families remain uncovered.

tests.name: native_powerpoint_cryptoapi_requires_the_password_and_preserves_encrypted_source
assertions: Missing and wrong passwords yield exact typed errors; correct public fixture password exposes one slide, two shapes and exact text under CryptoAPI RC4 128-bit; ordinary clear publication refuses, encrypted source passthrough is exact.
tests.scope_limit: No password change, newly encrypted save or native-app reopen claim.

tests.name: native_powerpoint_encryption_without_the_feature_is_explicitly_unsupported
assertions: Default-feature build returns UnsupportedEncryption(CryptoApi) even with the correct fixture password.
tests.scope_limit: Runs without encryption; CI has a standalone default-feature native PPT step. This is feature availability, not a claim that the supported profile cannot decrypt.

tests.name: native_powerpoint_custom_shows_follow_current_order_after_summary_insertion
assertions: Both named shows resolve exact ordered memberships before/after a Summary insertion; moving the first slide reads only the current document and remaps stable IDs; inverse restores exact source.
tests.scope_limit: Membership/read/order preservation only; no slideshow playback or custom-show CRUD claim.

tests.name: native_powerpoint_image_catalogs_resolve_every_stored_preview
assertions: Six native image-bearing PPT/PPS files expose the independent store counts 3/3/3/7/10/3 with nonempty payloads.
tests.scope_limit: Image catalog coverage; exact payload hashes are asserted separately for the media fixture, with no render or formula semantics.

tests.name: native_powerpoint_malformed_custom_show_name_is_an_error_not_an_empty_result
assertions: A lone UTF-16 surrogate introduced in memory produces a typed custom-show parse error rather than an empty list.
tests.scope_limit: Derived corruption; original native bytes remain unchanged.

tests.name: native_powerpoint_passive_macro_retains_module_source_without_execution
assertions: Native sync-flushed encoding is observable; exact VBAProject/Module1 source is decoded with one passive FixtureNoOp procedure; source publication is byte-identical.
tests.scope_limit: Source inspection only; no compilation or execution, and no macro mutation claim.

tests.name: native_ppt_table_query_edit_reopen_and_inverse_preserve_neighbor_cells
assertions: Public table query yields twelve resolvable cell paths; cell text edit survives reopen with exact neighbor values and inverse source restoration.
tests.scope_limit: One source-backed public table-cell transaction; other unified operations remain uncovered.
